correctness.rationale: Universal incidence-moment proof: nonempty distinct traces require size at least five; \(r_1\le5\) and three moment equalities force exactly one full 5-trace, hence a punctured block; pair-design axiom proves all 5 singleton and 10 doubleton traces. Distinct blocks intersect only two points, so the 96 codes form \(16K_6\) components. A self-contained stdlib verifier checks all 4368 five-sets and all exchange edges in one explicit design.
